queries.text: Why did a US court find Google's search business a monopoly, and what remedies were ordered?
The specific legal standard or test used by the US District Court to determine if Google held monopoly power in general web search, including the relevant market definition and share threshold
The percentage of global and US general web searches attributed to Google as cited in the court's findings for 2019-2023
The number of exclusive distribution agreements between Google and major device manufacturers (such as Apple) that were found to be anticompetitive, along with their annual payment values
The specific remedies ordered regarding the divestiture of Chrome browser, including whether it was mandated or rejected
The specific remedies ordered regarding Android operating system pre-installs on mobile devices, specifically which partners are prohibited from receiving payments for default status
The deadline date set by the court for compliance with the structural and conduct remedies

search_hits.title: The Google search-monopoly remedies (2024-2025)
search_hits.snippet: Judge Amit Mehta ruled Google a search monopolist on 2024-08-05; structural remedies followed on 2025-08-05.
